subject.title: feat(approvals): emit bold headers and labels in approval prompts

question: Should Markdown bolding become part of the single canonical approval-prompt text for all reaction-runtime channels, rather than remain an iMessage-only presentation change?
rationale: The patch deliberately broadens the presentation contract from the reported iMessage experience to Signal and WhatsApp, while those channels also consume visible text for approval correlation.

options.title: Approve the shared prompt contract
options.body: Keep the shared builder as the presentation owner, after a refresh confirms iMessage, Signal, and WhatsApp still bind formatted approval prompts correctly.

options.title: Limit styling to iMessage
options.body: Move the emphasis into the iMessage rendering boundary if maintainers want other channels to retain their existing canonical approval text.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared prompt contract
recommendation.body: Keep the shared builder as the presentation owner, after a refresh confirms iMessage, Signal, and WhatsApp still bind formatted approval prompts correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged format-profile work is the relevant current architecture for deciding whether shared Markdown presentation is the intended channel contract.
